name: acrelio-account-access-production-review-2026
description: Read-only Acrelio property and maintenance summaries for connected landlord accounts.

interface.longDescription: Securely review your own Acrelio property portfolio and maintenance requests in ChatGPT. See property addresses, request statuses, priorities, and estimated repair costs. Read-only: no tenant contact details, messaging, payments, approvals, or record changes.
defaultPrompt: List the properties in my connected Acrelio account.
Show urgent open maintenance requests and their estimated costs.

positive.description: Read the reviewer landlord’s property portfolio
positive.prompt: Show the properties in my connected Acrelio account, including their addresses. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only properties owned by the authenticated reviewer landlord, with property identifiers and addresses; no mutation.

positive.prompt: List my Acrelio maintenance requests with status, priority and estimated cost. Do not modify any records.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the reviewer landlord’s existing maintenance requests, with status, priority, and cost fields; exclude tenant contacts.

positive.prompt: Show only my open Acrelio maintenance requests.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke the maintenance reader with status=open; return only open requests and no changes.

positive.prompt: Are any of my Acrelio maintenance requests marked urgent? Show their estimated costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke the maintenance reader with priority=urgent, showing only authorized urgent records and estimated costs.

positive.description: Apply a bounded property result limit
positive.prompt: Show only one of my Acrelio properties, with its address.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit=1 and return no more than one property in the authorized portfolio.

negative.prompt: Delete my Acrelio test property now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin has no deletion/write capability; do not mutate a property.

negative.prompt: Send my tenant a message asking them to pay overdue rent.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send messages or imply that a message was delivered; explain the available tools are read-only.

negative.prompt: Show the phone numbers, email addresses and IDs of every tenant at my properties.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose tenant contacts/IDs that are outside the tools’ allowed response fields; explain the limitation.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process payments or perform transactions.

publication.release_notes: Production hostname preparation for the Acrelio public MCP review gateway (read-only). Connection, OAuth callback, domain verification and public activation are pending separate validation. Existing private integrations are unchanged.
